string.value:
Welcome to MG2! This guide window serves to explain some of the unique features found in MG2. If you're just starting out, we offer some additional #baccessibility#k and #bcustomization#k options not found in the original game so be sure to check out the "Setting Up" page.
You can access this window by pressing #bO#k or through the #bShortcut button#k on the Status Bar. To view the table of contents, use the drop down menu at the top.
We hope you enjoy your time here on MG2. Remember to use the feedback form on our website for inquiries, reports and requests!
#bhttps://rsvp.mdtz.eu/#k

string.name: name
string.value: Setting Up

In addition to the options present in the original game, MG2 offers other accessibility options to improve the overall experience. Here are some tips for setting up:
#e<Starting Out>#n
By now you've probably noticed when starting up MG2, it's in window mode by default. If you prefer playing the game in full-screen, use #bAlt+Enter#k. Screenshots are saved to the MapleGlobal folder which can be found in %appdata%, but this setting can be changed in #bSystem Options#k. Lastly, MG2 uses the official MapleStory patcher so, when updates are released, don't worry about re-downloading; the game will patch automatically.
#e<Foreign Language Support>#n
MG2 supports foreign characters and even offers additional means of communication. For more information, check the #bCommunicator#k section.
#e<Timed One-Time Passwords>#n
MG2 offers advanced account security in the form of #bTimed One-Time Passwords (TOTP)#k. To apply the TOTP to your account, first enter your login information on the login screen. While on the World Select screen, select the #bSetup TOTP#k button. You will be prompted to setup the QR code provided with an authentication app like #bAuthy#k or #bGoogle Authenticator#k. Remember: #edo not share this code with other players#n.
#e<Resolution>#n
You can change the game resolution from the standard (800x600) to HD (1366x768) in the #bSystem Options#k. If the long HP/MP/EXP bars aren't your thing, check the '#bStretch Status Bar#k' box under the #bAccessibility#k tab. We have taken care in making sure the Maple world looks great in both resolutions, so give it a try!
#e<Game Options>#n
The option to hide Megaphone messages and Maple Tips is available in the #bGame Options#k.
#e<System Options>#n
You can adjust the opacity of the chat bar as well as the color and darkness of tool tips to improve readability.
#e<Referrals>#n
MapleStory is a social game so if you bring some friends along, don't forget to refer them using your #breferral link#k. After signing up, you can login to the website to copy your link. Once the player you referred reaches #blevel 30#k for the first time, you'll both earn Cash to use in the Cash Shop!
If you have anything you'd like us to add, please send your feedback on the website. Happy Mapling!

#e<MG2's 2nd Birthday!>#n\n#rAvailable until 2022/11/09#k\nDuring the 2nd anniversary event you'll have a chance of finding #rmaple weapons#k while hunting monsters. All Maple weapons have above average stats!
Anniversary cakes and candles can be found roaming the Maple World. They could be the key to helping out #bCody#k and the #bMaple Administrator#k...

#e<Autumn is Here>#n\n#rAvailable until 2022/12/21#k\nAs the days get colder and leaves start to fall from the trees, #bCassandra#k celebrates the changing of the seasons by collecting Maple Leaves. Bring Cassandra the leaves you find for some #bspecial fall-themed items#k!
#e<Preparing for Halloween>#n\n#rAvailable until 2022/10/31#k\n#bCody#k's getting a head start on the Halloween festivities by making a costume and he needs your help!

#e<Trick or Treat!>#n
#r2022/10/23 ~ 2022/11/12#k
Halloween is around the corner and there's no better way to celebrate than with candy. The witch #bMalady#k is looking for candy found from monsters all around the world. There's even a special prize in store for the best candy collectors out there!
If you have an eye for fashion, you might be interested in #bshowing off your best Halloween-themed outfit#k! Dress up your character and your pet and submit a picture on the #bMG2 feedback form#k before the end of the event. Three awesome costumes will be chosen!
During the Halloween season we'll be running a brand new GM event called #bHalloween Hunt#k! This scavenger hunt event has you searching for Malady's lost broomstick, so keep an eye out for event messages!

#e<Turkey Season>#n\n#r2022/11/13 ~ 2022/11/27#k\nThere's nothing tastier than a Thanksgiving feast. Roasted Turkey and Corn can be found from Turkeys around Maple World, as well as some Thanksgiving-themed gear.
#bCody#k has a craving for Turkey eggs and he'll trade just about anything to get some. Exchange some eggs for a chance at a super-rare prize!

While traveling you might find some #bWooden Letters#k. The Maple Administrator is challenging everyone to find the right letters to spell out\n#bMAPLE STORY#k. Those who complete the challenge will be entered into a chance to win a ton of #bCash#k!

What's a Thanksgiving feast without dessert? Talk to #bGrandma Benson#k in #bHenesys#k to help her make her world-renowned #bpumpkin pie#k. For every pie you help make, you'll be earning points for your guild. The guild that makes the most pies by the end of the event will win big!

string.name: name
string.value: Internet Cafe

The Internet Cafe is a set of party-friendly quests based on the Internet Cafe in the original game. You can enter the Internet Cafe by talking to #bMonglong#k in #bKerning City#k or #bFranky#k in #bLudibrium Game Park#k. By talking to the Cafe receptionist inside, you can start a quest to find missing computer mouses. Completing the tasks inside the quest will earn you #bCafe Points#k.\n

Cafe Points can be exchanged with the receptionist for some prizes, including #bCash#k for the Cash Shop and #bCredits#k. Because MG2 doesn't take donations, this is the primary method used to earn Cash.
You can enter #bPremium Road#k, the zone inside the Computers, #btwice a day#k and all game modes can be done with or without a party.
Internet Cafe has two game modes:
#e<Monster Elimination>#n
In this mode, you'll find yourself in special hunting grounds unique to Internet Cafe. The goal is to find the lost computer mouses; each mouse will earn you and your party #b10 points#k. Monsters inside Premium Road may also carry special loot that you can't find anywhere else!
#e<Cafe Jump Challenge>#n
In this mode it's a race against a #b20 minute#k clock to complete all the familiar obstacle courses. Each stage completed will earn you and your party some points. The points earned and number of stages depends on the difficulty level and if everyone finishes the challenge in time, you'll be taken to the bonus map where you can earn even more points!

string.name: name
string.value: Monster Book

While hunting you will occasionally find monster cards; picking one up will immediately add the card to your collection. For every card you find, you'll be rewarded #b100 Cash#k and, when you complete a set, you'll get a bonus #b500 Cash#k!
As you collect cards you'll learn more about the monster:
#e<1 Card>#n
Monster's appearance.
#e<2 Cards>#n
Their HP/MP.
#e<3 Cards>#n
An in-depth description of the monster, its Level, and its strengths and weaknesses.
#e<4 Cards>#n
A detailed list of what the monster can drop, including the item's drop rates.
#e<5 Cards>#n
A list of the maps the monster can be found in.
You can open your Monster Book by pressing #bB#k or through the #bShortcut button#k on the Status Bar.

string.name: name
string.value: Cosmetic Inventory

With the #bCosmetic Inventory#k, you can take on the appearance of other equipment while retaining the stats of the gear you're already wearing. Open the Equipment Inventory with #bE#k and press Tab or select the "Cosmetic" button to open the Cosmetic Inventory. With this window open, double-click an equip in your Item Inventory to equip it cosmetically.
Level, Job, and Gender restrictions still apply, but other stat requirements do not. For weapons, the Weapon Type must match.

string.name: name
string.value: Scroll Enchantment

In MG2, there are alchemists found around the world who can create scrolls used to enchant gear using
#bBlank Scrolls#k.
Blank Scrolls come in 3 tiers:
#i4132000# #eLevel 1#n
Used to create weak scrolls (100% Scrolls).
#i4132001# #eLevel 2#n
Used to create medium strength scrolls (60% Scrolls).
#i4132002# #eLevel 3#n
Used to create powerful scrolls (10% Scrolls).

Level 1 Blank Scrolls can be purchased at general stores and every tier of Blank Scroll can be found from monsters and received as rewards in Party Quests. Blank Scrolls can also be created by these alchemists using a scroll that has already been enchanted. But be careful, removing the enchantment from a scroll can result in the scroll getting destroyed!\r\nThe recipes needed to enchant the scroll depend on the location of the alchemist and the strength of the scroll. Each recipe is a little different and will require you to hunt a different monster.

string.name: name
string.value: Rate Credits
To accommodate players from different time zones, or players with busy schedules, MG2 offers an alternative to timed EXP, Meso and Drop rate events in the form of #bRate Credits#k.

Credits can be redeemed at the Maple Administrator during special events and will last until they are used up. By default, credits will be disabled; once enabled, the time on them will only tick down while you're logged into a map with monsters to fight. An indicator that the credit is being used will appear in the top-right of the screen. Logging out or entering the Cash Shop will not use up time on your credit.\r\nCredits can also be purchased from the #bInternet Cafe#k. You can enable as many credits as you want, but only one credit of the same type can be used at a time starting with the largest rate modifier.

The #bCommunicator#k is a tool unique to MG2 that promotes communication between players from different regions using pre-written messages. You can open the Communicator with #b;#k or through the #bShortcut button#k on the Status Bar.
In the communicator window, select the message you would like to send. The message the other players receive will #bappear in their language regardless of how the message appears for you#k. The language the Communicator messages appear in depends on your computer's language which can be changed in your computer's settings.
Some options can be sent on their own, and others will require further input. For example: selecting "#bI'd like to buy...#k" will then prompt you to select an item on the right side of the window. Messages sent through the communicator will appear as a light green in the chat.
This tool is still a work in progress and at this time only #bEnglish#k, #bKorean#k,
#bSpanish#k, #bFrench#k, #bPortuguese#k and
#bChinese#k are supported. We appreciate any feedback you can give us as we continue updating it in the future!

string.name: name
string.value: Version Differences

MG2 is an emulation of classic MapleStory using GMS #ev0.12#n as the foundation. As a result, some of the content and features players are familiar with may not exist in this version. As MG2 has grown we have implemented some of the content from later versions, but the overall experience may still be unfamiliar. Here are some of the features available in MG2:
#e<Available Regions>#n
- Maple Island
- Victoria Island
- Orbis & El Nath
- Aquarium
- Ludibrium
- Omega Sector
#e<Quests>#n
In this version of the game, there were no visual indicators for available quests. There is also no way to forfeit a quest once you have started it.
The contents of some quests may differ as well. So talk to everyone you see, they may just have a quest for you!
#e<Personal Shops>#n
In addition to the Free Market, you can open Personal Shops #balmost anywhere#k. Because Hired Merchants don't exist, we offer players the option to host their shops while offline. This means you can host your shop on one character while playing on another on the #bsame account#k. To host a shop while offline, open your shop and select the "Log Out" button at the top right of the shop window.
Shops will only remain open for #r72 hours#k, so remember to update your shops from time to time.
#e<Pets>#n
In MG2, you won't need to purchase separate items in order for your pet to loot items or mesos. Pets will loot mesos #bautomatically#k and they'll loot all other items at #bLevel 5#k.
In this version, Pets cannot use potions or travel to pick up items.
#e<Blocklist>#n
Available in future versions, this feature is a standalone window that can be bound to a key in Key Settings or opened in the Shortcut Menu.
#e<Dropped Equipment>#n
If you've ever been eager to see what stats an item has before looting it, this feature may be for you. You can see the stats of any equipment on the ground by moving the cursor over it!

#e<Maple Weapons>#n
The inclusion of these weapons in the official game had a big impact on the game's existing meta, and it is for this reason we opted to re-balance them in MG2. With that said, because these are special limited-time items, they will still have benefits over their regular weapon counterparts. Their stats mirror weapons #b10 levels higher#k while requirements to equip the weapon will mirror weapons #bof the same level#k.
#e<NPC Chat>#n
Press #bSpacebar#k to talk to NPCs close to you.
#e<Chat Shortcuts>#n
You can clear all messages in the chat bar by typing '#b/clear#k' in the chat bar. Other chat shortcuts usually unavailable in MapleStory, like #bCtrl+A#k, can also be used!
#e<EXP Statistics>#n
By hovering over the EXP bar on the Status Bar, you can see the projected percent of EXP that can be earned per hour. It will also display the total amount of EXP earned in the last hour. You can reset the counter by double-clicking your EXP bar.
